title: Associativity of the intrinsic semilinear compositors
statement: For every inverse sequence of commutative rings, the specified intrinsic inverse-image compositors, their right-adjoint direct-image compositors, and the open-extension compositors [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons] satisfy the three associativity equations of compositor_associativity on the entire unbounded derived categories. The equations include the equality transport from (f ≫ g) ≫ h to f ≫ (g ≫ h), and are componentwise equalities of the actual selected comparisons, without a faithfulness-of-evaluation assumption.

source.place: Tags 0F7C--0F7F: the proper/open compositor associativity argument in the existing intrinsic mate-pasting node.

proof.text: On ordinary modules, evaluate the two composites on a section of a test object. The direct-image formulas restrict along the same iterated pullback map, by restriction_pasting and site_pasting of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-direct-image-coherence].

Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc to the chosen ordinary adjunctions and the proved push coherence. Equality elimination gives the transport term for the associativity of scheme morphisms.
Apply descend_coherence of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-direct-image-coherence] to exact localization of the inverse-image functors; its transport formula identifies the chosen derived comparison.

Conjugate the derived inverse-image associativity along the proper and open adjunctions. The conjugate_triangle_assoc calculation of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-direct-image-coherence], and Mathlib leftAdjointCompIso_assoc, prove the two remaining equations. Cancel the invertible terminal transport maps.

lean.statement:
theorem compositor_associativity :
    (∀ {X Y Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T)
      (M : Derived C τ T),
      (pComp C τ (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M ≫
        (pComp C τ f g).hom.app ((P C τ h).obj M) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (P C τ) (Category.assoc f g h))).hom.app M ≫
        (pComp C τ f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫
        (P C τ f).map ((pComp C τ g h).hom.app M)) ∧
    (∀ {X Y Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T)
      (M : Derived C τ X),
      (R C τ h).map ((sComp C τ f g).hom.app M) ≫
        (sComp C τ (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M =
      (sComp C τ g h).hom.app ((R C τ f).obj M) ≫
        (sComp C τ f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫
        (eqToIso (congrArg (R C τ) (Category.assoc f g h))).inv.app M) ∧
    (∀ {X Y Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T)
      [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion h]
      (M : Derived C τ X),
      (J C τ h).map ((jComp C τ f g).hom.app M) ≫
        (jComp C τ (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M =
      (jComp C τ g h).hom.app ((J C τ f).obj M) ≫
        (jComp C τ f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫
        (jCongr C τ (Category.assoc f g h)).inv.app M)
